channel.title: Medics Musings: FDA recall roundup
channel.description: FDA drug, device and food recalls from the last 30 days, updated weekly from openFDA.

item.title: Class I drug recall: Dextrose Injection, USP, 70 %, 2000 mL bags, Rx Only, Baxter Healthcare Corporation Deerfi (Baxter Healthcare Corporation)
item.description: Presence of Particulate Matter: particulate matter identified as stainless steel particles in the solution. Recalling firm: Baxter Healthcare Corporation. Status: Ongoing.

item.title: Class I device recall: Kit: Single Shot Epidural 20/Cs, REF: 59553; Kit: Single Shot Epidural 20/Cs, REF: 83945B. (Medical Action Industries, Inc. 306)
item.description: Kits containing Sodium Chloride ampules subject to another recall are recalled due to potentially compromised sterility. Recalling firm: Medical Action Industries, Inc. 306. Status: Ongoing.

item.title: Class I device recall: Kit: Epidural/Pain TQC 20/Cs, REF: 82465 Containing Sodium Chloride Injection, 0.9%, USP 1 (Medical Action Industries, Inc. 306)

item.title: Class I device recall: Bravo CF capsule delivery device, 5-pack, Product Number FGS-0635, Bravo CF capsule delive (Given Imaging Ltd.)
item.description: Capsule may fail to attach to the esophagus or detach from the delivery device. Risks include patient aspiration/inhalation, perforation of esophagus, obstruction of the airway, hemorrhage/blood loss/bleeding… Recalling firm: Given Imaging Ltd.. Status: Ongoing.
